cards.zh: 我已经等了四十分钟了
cards.en: I've been [[on hold]] for forty minutes.
cards.mine: I've been waiting in the line for 40 minutes.
cards.note: 电话排队等待叫 on hold

cards.zh: 能帮我转到账单部门吗？
cards.en: Could you [[put me through to]] billing?
cards.mine: Can you transfer me to the billing department?

cards.en: [[Hang on a sec]], I'll grab my account number.
cards.mine: Please wait me a moment, I find my account number.
Sorry, the phone was broken just now.

cards.zh: 你那边声音断断续续的
cards.mine: Sorry, your signal is not good.
I want to make a complain.
cards.note: complain 是动词，名词是 complaint

cards.zh: 账单上有一笔我不认识的扣费
cards.en: There's a charge on my bill I [[don't recognise]].
cards.mine: There's a fee I don't know on my bill.

us.en: There's a charge on my bill I [[don't recognize]].

cards.mine: I want to argue this payment.
cards.note: 对扣费提出异议用 dispute

cards.mine: I was double deducted this month.
I want to unsubscribe my plan.

cards.zh: 我的合约什么时候到期？
cards.mine: When will my contract be expired?

cards.zh: 提前解约要交违约金吗？
cards.en: Is there a fee to [[break the contract]]?
cards.mine: Is there penalty money if I cancel contract early?

cards.zh: 能把钱退回到我账户吗？
cards.en: Can you [[credit]] that [[back]] to my account?
cards.mine: Can you return the money to my account?
Can I find your leader?
cards.note: 找主管说 speak to，不说 find

cards.mine: My internet is not stable these days.

cards.zh: 能换个便宜点的套餐吗？
cards.mine: Can I change to a cheaper package?

cards.en: Could I [[book in]] for Thursday morning?
cards.mine: I want to make a booking on Thursday morning.

us.en: Could I [[schedule something]] for Thursday morning?

cards.mine: Is there a more early time?
I need to change the appointment time.

cards.zh: 你们说会回电话，结果没人打
cards.en: I was told I'd [[get a call back]], but nobody did.
cards.mine: You said will call me back but nobody called.

cards.zh: 能在我账户上备注一下吗？
cards.en: Can you [[make a note on]] my account?
cards.mine: Can you write down it in the system?

cards.zh: 我在考虑换一家运营商
cards.mine: I'm thinking of changing to other company.

cards.zh: 价格上能不能再优惠点？
cards.en: Is there [[anything you can do]] on the price?
cards.mine: Can you give me some discount?

cards.en: Could you [[read that back]] to me?
cards.mine: Can you say it again one more time?
I lost my card, I want to stop it.
